text: Appeal of Order to Comply for 3 Mossom Place.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Deferred consideration of the Order to Comply, dated January 30, 2020, regarding the property located at 3 Mossom Place, Folder No. 20 110112 PRS 00 IV, to its next scheduled in-person meeting in order to allow the hearing to be heard in-person, as requested by the Appellant's representative.
